what_it_does: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited operates as an electronics manufacturing services (EMS) provider, offering design, manufacturing, and assembly solutions for mobile phones, consumer electronics, home appliances, lighting, telecom products, and IT hardware to global and domestic brands, generating revenue through contract manufacturing and sales.
other_facts: Dixon operates 30 state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities spread across approximately 6.4 million sq. ft. of manufacturing space in India.
The company recorded a consolidated revenue of ₹48,893 Crores for FY 2025-26.
Annual production capacities include 65 million units of smartphones and 40 million units of feature phones.
